_DESCRIPTION: Change the values below to customize the app's behavior, language and sounds WITHOUT touching the source code or the .exe. Keep this 'settings' folder in the SAME folder as KediTopTakibi.exe; it is re-read every time the app starts.
_LANGUAGE_NOTE: File name (without extension) inside the settings/lang folder. Default is Turkish ('tr'). To add a new language, drop e.g. 'de.json' into settings/lang and set this to 'de'. No recompilation needed.
_LANGUAGE_FOLDER_NOTE: Name of the subfolder (inside settings) that contains the language files.
_SOUND_FILE_NOTE: Sound file path, relative to the settings folder. Drop your own .wav file into settings/assets and change the file name here to customize it. No recompilation needed.
